pages.title: Batch Placement
pages.text: Use valid clay on the wheel. Sneak-place primary input on the top plate: centre loads one, middle two, outer ring three. This special placement targets primary input, rather than an optional recipe catalyst.

pages.title: Shape by Hand
pages.text: Empty-hand use works the wheel or collects ready output. Sneak-empty-hand use retrieves stored material. The default Tuyere needs one Refractory Clay and six work; Casting Mold needs two and eight; Crucible needs three and eight.

pages.title: Fire the Parts
pages.text: Output ceramics are unfired. Smelt them in a normal furnace before construction. The Kiln heats workpieces and cannot fire pottery. Packs can add workshop ingredients, catalysts, catalyst consumption, and work requirements.
